title: Oven Roasted Welsh Red Potatoes Gratin
description: A delicious and hearty Welsh dish featuring roasted red potatoes in a mustardy glaze, perfect for a date night dinner. This low-fat-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
In a separate bowl, mix together the whole wheat breadcrumbs, grated cheddar cheese, and chopped parsley.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
Brush the layer of potatoes with dijon mustard.
Sprinkle a third of the breadcrumb mixture over the potatoes.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of breadcrumbs on top.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
